sources.tensor: T_ijkl = product(alpha_j!) * ordinary_c_alpha; alpha counts i,j,k,l
sources.V: V_ijkl = M_ij M_kl + M_ik M_jl + M_il M_jk
sources.W: W_ijkl = M_ij v_k v_l + M_ik v_j v_l + M_il v_j v_k + M_jk v_i v_l + M_jl v_i v_k + M_kl v_i v_j
sources.H: H(S) = sum_(sigma,tau,upsilon in S6) sgn(sigma)sgn(tau)sgn(upsilon) product_(i=0..5) S_i,sigma(i),tau(i),upsilon(i)
